name: Emboss
author: Erin Carter
description: A deep quilted surface of padded diamond cushions, pulled in at the button points and creased along the seams, lit as a soft satin so every pucker carries a specular bloom. The fabric is iridescent shot silk - hue shifts across the curve of each cushion and the highlights flash a complementary colour - sweeping slowly across the whole frame. All relief and colour, no flat grid.

params.label: Cushion size
params.effect: Size of each padded diamond cushion in CSS pixels - a dense fine quilting at the minimum, a few large plush pillows at the maximum.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Depth of the padding; low is a shallow pressed quilt, high swells the cushions into deep rounded pillows with sharp seam creases.

params.label: Iridescence
params.effect: How far the shot-silk hue travels across each cushion and how fast it drifts; 0 is a near-solid satin, 1 a full rainbow sheen rolling over the relief.

params.label: Sheen
params.effect: Strength of the satin specular highlight on each pucker - matte at 0, a wet glossy bloom at the maximum.

params.label: Scatter
params.effect: Randomizes each button so it is not pinned dead-centre in its cushion; 0 is a perfectly regular quilt, 1 throws the pucker points around for a hand-stitched, irregular tuft.

params.label: Light/Dark
params.effect: Spread between the lit and shadowed satin; low lifts the shadows toward an even flat light, high drops the ambient floor and drives the diffuse into deep contrast.

params.label: Light angle
params.effect: Compass bearing of the key light across the cloth; rotate it to move the lit faces and shadows around each cushion.

params.label: Light height
params.effect: How high the key light sits; low is a raking grazing light that throws long cushion shadows, high is a flatter top light.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Turns the whole quilt off the 45-degree diamond onto any bias while the lighting stays put.

params.label: Skew
params.effect: Shears the lattice so the diamond cushions lean into rhombic tufts instead of upright squares.

params.label: Tilt
params.effect: Lays the quilt back in perspective; one edge recedes and its cushions shrink while the near edge swells, turning the flat tufting into a surface seen at an angle.

params.label: Depth shade
params.effect: Strength of a light-to-shade gradient that follows the tilt and skew - the receding side sinks into shadow and the near side catches the light. Has no effect on a flat quilt; comes alive as you tilt or skew.
